title: Model-Lab Condition-Contrast Design Gate v1
description: Machine-readable criteria gate that defines what a future Model-Lab Run-004 condition-contrast design must satisfy. It is a design-criteria gate only: it deliberately does NOT select a primary intervention axis, does NOT select a concrete condition, does NOT execute Run-004, does NOT allow a result_assessment, does NOT make the series comparison-ready, and does NOT resolve weak_condition_contrast. It records gate_status, that a future Run-004 design may begin while Run-004 execution / result assessment / comparison stay forbidden after the gate, the source evidence it is anchored to (exactly one next_blocker_triage and exactly one result_assessment_readiness for the same series), the required single-primary-axis contrast policy, the invariant outcome surfaces, the controlled secondary dimensions, the materiality criteria, the confounder controls, a decision, and an anti-overclaim does_not_establish boundary. Form is validated here. Semantic validation (scripts/docmeta/validate_model_lab_condition_contrast_design_gate.py) requires the triage to recommend condition_contrast_design_gate for the open target_blocker, the readiness gate to remain explicitly blocked, the target_blocker to stay open in both sources, exactly one primary intervention axis, complete invariant / materiality / confounder sets with unique ids, status/permission consistency, forbidden execution and assessment, the mandatory non-claims, and only existing repo-internal evidence paths.

gate_status.$comment: v1 models two states. 'criteria_defined' is the normal emitted state once the cross-artifact preconditions hold and the criteria are complete; the validator then requires run_004_design_allowed=true. 'blocked' is the conservative counterpart; the validator then requires run_004_design_allowed=false (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_STATUS_PERMISSION_CONSISTENCY). Neither state ever allows Run-004 execution, result assessment, or comparison.

target_blocker.$comment: Semantically this must be the blocker the triage recommends this gate for and that stays open in both the triage and the readiness gate (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_TRIAGE_RECOMMENDATION / CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_OPEN_TARGET_BLOCKER). The expected value (weak_condition_contrast) is read from the source artifacts, not hardcoded into the form.

blocker_status_after_gate.$comment: In v1 the gate never closes its target blocker: defining criteria is not resolving the blocker. The only form-valid value is 'open'.

run_004_design_allowed.$comment: Coupled to gate_status by the validator: criteria_defined => true, blocked => false (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_STATUS_PERMISSION_CONSISTENCY). Allowing a *design* task is not allowing a *run*.

run_004_execution_allowed.$comment: In v1 this must be false. true is rejected by the validator (CONTRAST_GATE_FORBIDS_EXECUTION_AND_ASSESSMENT); a design-criteria gate never authorizes execution.

result_assessment_allowed_after_gate.$comment: In v1 this must be false (CONTRAST_GATE_FORBIDS_EXECUTION_AND_ASSESSMENT); defining contrast criteria does not authorize a result assessment.

comparison_ready_after_gate.$comment: In v1 this must be false (CONTRAST_GATE_FORBIDS_EXECUTION_AND_ASSESSMENT); defining contrast criteria does not make the series comparison-ready.

source_evidence.$comment: Semantically: exactly one next_blocker_triage and exactly one readiness_gate are required (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_TRIAGE_SOURCE / CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_READINESS_SOURCE), both for this gate's own series_id. assessment_context and method_context are non-foundational context sources: only their existence and path safety are checked, never their free-text prose.

invariant_dimensions.$comment: Outcome surfaces that a future design must keep fixed. The validator requires the mandatory ids (challenge_contract, acceptance_surface, evaluation_criteria, verification_surface, evidence_capture) to all be present (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CRITERIA).

materiality_criteria.$comment: The validator requires the mandatory ids (single_primary_intervention_axis, operationally_verifiable_difference, no_cosmetic_relabeling, fixed_outcome_surface, provenance_before_execution) and, when contrast_policy.materiality_evidence_required is true, non-empty evidence_required on every criterion (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CRITERIA).

confounder_controls.$comment: The validator requires the mandatory ids (multi_axis_drift, acceptance_or_test_drift, unequal_human_intervention, dependency_or_runtime_drift, post_hoc_condition_rework, self_reported_independence_as_external_proof) to all be present (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CONFOUNDER_CONTROLS).

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. Must include the baseline non-claims enforced by the validator: weak_condition_contrast_resolved, run_004_execution_allowed, run_004_executed, result_assessment_allowed, comparison_ready, model_quality, comparative_superiority, condition_effect, external_model_independence, external_auditor_comparison_completed, security_readiness, production_readiness, dependency_risk_remediated.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are rejected here; parent-escape ('..') and symlink-out-of-repo are rejected semantically by the validator with a stable rule id.

kind.$comment: Provenance label, e.g. next_blocker_triage, readiness_gate, assessment_context, method_context. The validator cross-checks 'next_blocker_triage' (must be a model_lab_next_blocker_triage artifact for this series, recommending this gate for the open target_blocker) and 'readiness_gate' (must be a blocked result_assessment_readiness artifact for this series and challenge_version).

contrastPolicy.$comment: The validator requires primary_intervention_axis_required=true and required_primary_intervention_axis_count==1 (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_PRIMARY_AXIS_POLICY). The integer minimum stays 0 in the form so that a non-1 count is reported as a stable semantic rule rather than a raw schema error.

materialityCriterion.$comment: evidence_required is form-optional so a missing/empty evidence list surfaces as a stable semantic rule (CONTRAST_GATE_REQUIRES_COMPLETE_CRITERIA) when contrast_policy.materiality_evidence_required is true, rather than as a raw schema error.
